H.title: Required-asset safety can be relabeled into a waivable or advisory rule
H.status: CONFIRMED contract/publication admission; downstream selection bypass is a conditional risk, not an executed exploit
H.scenario: Start with the shipped policy_v2_data fixture: video.required=True and video.constraint_rule_id=asset-video. Change that referenced rule_class to METADATA_LINT and list asset-video as waivable. PlatformConstraintSnapshot checks only ID existence; QualityPolicyV2 checks only the supplied class. Validation and the A pure publication path accept the policy. Independently, a REQUIRED_ASSET rule with severity ADVISORY is admitted. D3 selection allows listed blocking waivers and ignores advisory findings, so a B2/B3 implementation following these admitted labels can make missing required video selectable. This leaves the prior N3 non-waivable safety resolution incomplete.
H.fix: Before B2, bind safety semantics to policy structure/server-owned rule definitions rather than caller-supplied labels. Validate that required-role presence rules have the mandatory safety class and blocking severity; likewise ensure integrity/closure/currentness checks cannot be downgraded to waivable/advisory semantics. Add RED cases for misclassification, advisory downgrade and publication admission. B2 must enforce these invariants independently of waiver input.
H.design_basis: D4; prior design-r2-delta-review N3; non-waivable integrity/required-asset/closure/currentness boundary.

M.title: Constraint snapshot cannot express charset and per-hashtag length policy
M.scenario: D4 requires tag/hashtag count, charset and per-item length in the published snapshot. The model has max_tags, max_tag_chars and max_hashtags, but no charset setting or explicit hashtag item limit. Supplying charset or max_hashtag_chars is extra_forbidden. A platform revision that changes allowed metadata characters or hashtag length therefore cannot be represented or bound by its constraint digest; B2 would need an undocumented hardcoded setting or another schema change.
M.fix: Add explicit character policy and hashtag item-length fields, or document and approve an exact shared tag/hashtag character/length policy represented by named fields. Freeze the updated vectors and add field-mutation/invalid-policy cases before freezing B2 input contracts.

M.title: Variant alternatives cannot carry their required provenance
M.scenario: Section 3.3 specifies each variant as variant_id, value/asset reference and provenance. PackagingVariant has only variant_id/value/asset_role and rejects provenance. Candidate provenance identifies only content or presentation, with no group/variant key. If an agent authors one title and a Human authors another, the immutable payload cannot record which principal authored which selectable alternative.
M.fix: Add immutable per-variant provenance with server-derived author identity, include it in closure/candidate digests, and update vectors. Prove both alternative authors survive round trip and provenance changes alter the bound digest. Reject client authority claims at the later append input boundary.

M.title: Export manifest omits the explicitly required chosen variant identities
M.scenario: The preview has selected_variant_ids, but ExportManifest contains no chosen-variant field and rejects selected_variant_ids as extra_forbidden. Section 3.3 requires the manifest itself to record the chosen ids. A detached bundle reader can see only opaque selection_digest and candidate_payload_digest, not the selected alternatives; adding the required record in B4 would change the supposedly frozen B1 manifest shape/vector.
M.fix: Add a canonical chosen-variant representation to ExportManifest, preferably group-to-variant bindings, and require B4 construction/finalization to match the selection preview exactly. Freeze the vector and add missing/duplicate/wrong-choice cases.
M.design_basis: Section 3.3: manifest records the chosen ids.

M.title: B1 domain/vector freeze is incomplete
M.scenario: Section 3.1 includes m10.export-execution.v1 and freezes the B domains in B1. The domain is absent and an existing test still requires it to be unregistered. The registered packaging-observation, package-selection-request, package-selection and export-request domains also have no frozen GOLDEN vector in test_packaging. Their projections can change while the current golden tests remain green; B4 cannot use the specified execution binding through compute_digest.
M.fix: Complete the export execution contract/projection and freeze all listed domain vectors, including request cache exclusion and scalar mutation checks. If export-execution is deliberately deferred, record an explicit accepted B1 scope exception with B4 as its gate; still freeze the four already implemented domains in this packet.
M.design_basis: Section 3.1 Domains / Golden vectors frozen in B1; section 8 Contracts.
